title: Pointer tree of nested spans
summary: Each opening symbol creates a node whose pointer goes to the enclosing node; a closer returns to the parent node, and the readout names the closer of the current node.
core_idea: Grow a pointer tree of open spans and predict the closer of the current node.

state.name: lumbard
state.meaning: Pointer tree of open spans; each node points at its enclosing node.

update.name: step
update.latex: lumbard_t = new node with pointer to lumbard_(t-1) if x_t opens, else parent node
update.plain: lumbard_t = new node with pointer to lumbard_(t-1) if x_t opens, else parent node

learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: Predicts the right closer after one example.

capabilities.prediction: Predicts the legal closer at any depth.

known_relatives.name: not assessed

falsifiers: A node loses its parent pointer.

toy_example.python:
import json
parent = {1: 0, 2: 1}
node = 2
node = parent[node]
print(json.dumps({'node': node}))
